subject: CS401: Distributed Systems - Lab 3 Submission Cutoff Tonight
body:
Dear students,

This is a final reminder that Lab 3 (Raft Consensus Implementation) is due tonight at 11:59 PM. Late submissions will receive a 20% penalty per day. Ensure your test cases pass the grade-runner script at https://grades.university.edu/cs401/lab3.

Best,
Prof. Turing

subject: MATH302: Midterm Exam Date Shifted & Practice Problem Set
body:
Hello Class,

body: Hey everyone! Join us for movie night this Friday at 8 PM in the amphitheater. Popcorn will be provided. Also, check out the lost & found in room 104 if you lost an umbrella last Tuesday.

subject: CS205: Homework 2 Extension Granted
